instruction:
Create morph_mcp/tools.py for Python 3.9: the tool layer of an MCP server exposing this project's Morph 2.0 batch orchestrator. Standard library plus this project only; import from cards.store / cards.schema (see context) and never from flows.
Provide exactly two public names:
  TOOLS -- a list of tool descriptors, each {'name':str,'description':str,'inputSchema':{'type':'object','properties':{...},'required':[...]}} for these four tools:
    deck_status  -- no arguments; returns a human-readable rendering of the backlog: every card with its status (pending/in_flight/written/failed/skipped) and the generation composition.
    card_add     -- argument 'card' (object): one morph card in flat or nested form; adds it to the backlog and returns a confirmation naming the custom_id and target.
    deck_submit  -- optional argument 'processor' (string): compiles and submits the current generation; returns what was submitted. 
    deck_collect -- no arguments; collects the in-flight generation, verifies and integrates it; returns the per-card outcome.
  call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict, root: str = '.') -> str -- dispatch by name against a DeckStore rooted at 'root', returning TEXT (never a dict). An unknown tool name raises ValueError. 'root' MUST be honoured so a caller can drive a deck in any directory.
For deck_submit / deck_collect build the batch backend from the processor registry (processors.registry.ProcessorRegistry.from_env) INSIDE the call, so importing this module needs no configuration; if no processor is configured, return a clear message instead of raising.
Output ONLY the complete file inside one ```python fenced code block, no commentary.
